title: Perzyna viscoplasticity with backward Euler return map
objective: Add a Perzyna-type viscoplastic constitutive model alongside the existing `j2_power_law`. The model extends J2 with a rate-dependent overstress-viscosity term and uses implicit backward Euler for the return mapping.
scope: Add `mechdsl.symbolic.models.perzyna` implementing the Perzyna overstress law and the corresponding backward-Euler return map.
Expose it through `build_context` as `material_type='perzyna'` with params `(E, nu, sigma_y0, K, n, eta, m)` where (eta, m) are the Perzyna viscosity and rate-sensitivity exponent.
Follow the same module shape as `j2_power_law` (dataclass, `radial_return` function, `ReturnMappingResult` with stress/alpha/tangent).
At eta → 0 the model must reduce exactly to rate-independent J2 — add this as a regression test.
implementation_steps: Read `j2_power_law.py` to pick up the existing structure.
Add `PerzynaMaterial` dataclass with field validation (eta > 0, m > 0).
Implement `radial_return` with a Newton iteration on the rate-dependent yield consistency equation.
Add `ReturnMappingResult` including the algorithmic tangent (filled by P3-3 — stub with the elastic tangent for now).
Add unit tests: rate-independent limit, monotonicity under increasing strain rate, quasi-static limit.
acceptance_criteria: At eta = 1e-12, Perzyna produces the same stress as rate-independent J2 power-law to 1e-8.
At eta = 1.0 (high viscosity), stress increases with strain rate (monotonic).
Return mapping Newton iteration converges in < 30 iterations on the test cases.

cases: Rate sensitivity: high strain rate gives higher stress
Quasi-static limit at low strain rate matches J2

risks: The rate-dependent consistency equation is stiff at small eta. Mitigation: add a line search and a fall-back bisection step when Newton stalls.
completion_notes: Module `mechdsl/symbolic/models/perzyna.py` implements PerzynaMaterial dataclass + radial_return + ReturnMappingResult mirroring j2_power_law.
Registered `perzyna` in allowlists across frontend.build_context, ProblemIR.material validation, and lowering.fe_localise supported-models frozenset.
Taichi printer deliberately keeps emission to svk / j2_power_law; error message updated to point at future integration task.
Elastic tangent is used as a stub inside ReturnMappingResult until P3-3 fills in the consistent viscoplastic tangent (two test stubs in TestTaskP3_3PerzynaTangent skipped pending P3-3).
